$comment: Design-quality baseline for scripts/check-design-quality.mjs. `waivers` are accepted on purpose and each names the check that covers the same risk. `outstanding` is the work left to do; it may only shrink without a commit that explains why it grew.

waivers.reason: NASA HDS design tokens and typography stack vendor Inter for fallback body typography; verified byte-for-byte in __tests__/nasaTokens.test.js.

Detector artifact. -0.58em matches no declaration in frontend/src or the built CSS, and every hit is FAQ question text (480 hits; 478 sit inside <summary>). Real tracking is pinned by __tests__/appleParity.test.js: each role's CSS equals APPLE_TYPE, -0.015em to +0.012em. Re-open if a declared tracking below -0.1em appears.

Spec decision. DESIGN.md names Inter first in every text stack, but Inter is not shipped: frontend/public/fonts/README.md caps local fonts at 50 KiB and the Bengali face uses 43.3 KiB. Stacks fall back to the platform sans. __tests__/appleParity.test.js pins the Inter-first stacks and that no Inter file ships. Revisit with the font-budget decision.

Detector artifact, verified against the shipped cascade. The no-JS shell h1 is 28px/32px (Apple headline-lg), and the authored screen h1 is 32px mobile / 44px desktop; the detector reads an 18pt print h1 as 288px by treating points as rem. __tests__/designTypography.test.js keeps point sizes inside print/paper scopes and caps screen h1 at the DESIGN.md headline-xl size of 44px. Re-open if a screen h1 exceeds 44px.

Detector false positive in prerendered documentation. On a disposable copy of frontend/dist/docs.html, removing the linked Vite stylesheet removes every tracking hit (only the unrelated font finding remains); the emitted static markup has no .tracking-tight class or -0.72em declaration, and its inline styles use only positive .025em tracking. The detector is attributing utility typography from the linked SPA bundle to no-JS static copy. The static shell's body/table/disclosure selectors are checked by __tests__/docsStaticTypography.test.js; authored Apple typography remains bounded by __tests__/appleParity.test.js. Re-open if negative tracking is introduced for static body copy.

Detector artifact from the linked production stylesheet on prerendered FAQ summaries. In a disposable frontend/dist/districts/brahmanbaria.html, removing the stylesheet link removes these tracking findings; no -0.54em declaration exists in authored source or emitted CSS. The authored Apple roles are pinned by __tests__/appleParity.test.js (−0.015em to +0.012em), and __tests__/docsStaticTypography.test.js rejects negative tracking on static reading text. Re-open if an authored declaration below −0.1em appears.

Valid compact Apple type roles in the prerendered shell: 17/22 headline-sm and 14/18 body-sm or label-md both resolve to 1.29x. The generic detector does not know the token roles. __tests__/designTypography.test.js now loads exact Apple size/line pairs from apple.css and permits only those pairs below 1.3; all other non-token authored body leading remains >=1.3.

Valid compact Apple caption role in the prerendered shell: 11/14 resolves to 1.27x by design. The generic detector does not know the token role. __tests__/designTypography.test.js loads exact Apple size/line pairs from apple.css and permits only those pairs below 1.3; all other non-token authored body leading remains >=1.3.

Detector artifact: its built-page parser treats a print stylesheet point size as rem, producing a 306px h1. In a disposable frontend/dist/hazards/flood.html, removing the linked stylesheet removes the finding; source CSS keeps point sizes inside print/paper scopes and screen h1 at <=44px, enforced by __tests__/designTypography.test.js. Re-open if an authored screen h1 exceeds 44px.

Detector artifact on prerendered documentation text. Removing the production stylesheet link from disposable frontend/dist/docs.html removes these hits; no -0.77em declaration exists in authored source, the static shell, or the emitted CSS. __tests__/docsStaticTypography.test.js asserts all static body/disclosure declarations have non-negative tracking, and __tests__/appleParity.test.js pins actual Apple roles to −0.015em…+0.012em. Re-open if an authored declaration below −0.1em appears.
